_comment: The interpreter and package stack benchmark artifacts in this
directory were produced under, and which run_benchmark.py requires.
It exists because `python` on a typical dev PATH is NOT this
interpreter: on the author's machine bare `python` resolves to a
3.10 GIL build with NumPy 1.26, while the benchmarks and
RESULTS.md declare 3.14 free-threading with NumPy 2.4. Recording
the interpreter -- which the manifest already did -- does not stop
a run on the wrong one; this file is what lets the wrapper refuse.
Compared at major.minor, so patch bumps do not trip it.
